messages.text:
The installed Start server-function transform is not firing in dev the way it does in the production build.

I’m going to move read loaders onto server-side route loaders backed by the API module, then use standard HTTP route handlers for client mutations if needed.

First I’m checking the route API surface exposed by the installed router/start packages.
